tonight.headline: Up 39.9 with every starter locked — Bok-aneers need about 40 from Kraft and Lloyd
body: Bad news first: Tyler Allgeier has 4.7 late in Arizona's game, with Bam Knight taking 14 touches to his 15, while Alvin Kamara scored 14.9 on your bench. Josh Allen had 10 at the half in Las Vegas (13-13). None of it is in danger of costing the week.
Nothing to do. Your whole lineup is locked; Bok-aneers have only Tucker Kraft and MarShawn Lloyd left tonight, 23.1 projected, against a 39.9-point deficit. ESPN: 99%.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every AVIATO starter has kicked off. Love (tonight) and McLaurin (Monday) are on the bench behind locked starters, so nothing on the roster can move until Week 7.

case.label: The Allgeier number
case.body: 13 carries and 2 targets to Knight's 14 touches (live archive, in progress). Arizona called Allgeier the lead (AZCardinals.com 16 Oct); the split today was nearer even. That matters for Tuesday's Week 7 back, not tonight.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Kraft and Lloyd combining for 40 tonight — about 1.7 times their projection together. Nothing you can act on either way.

doFirst.title: Start Jordan Love for Josh Allen in Week 7
doFirst.subtitle: Buffalo are on bye. Swap the moment Week 7 opens — no projection needed.

case.label: The bye
case.body: Buffalo's bye is Week 7 (ESPN file), and so are Jacksonville's (Tuten) and Washington's (McLaurin). Love's Green Bay bye is Week 11. Love was added on 15 Oct for exactly this week.

case.label: The rest of Week 7
case.body: Jefferson and Gordon return from byes. Tuten's running-back slot goes to whoever Tuesday's Week 7 projection prefers among Gordon, Allgeier and Kamara — and Arizona split Allgeier's work with Bam Knight today (live archive), so that is a real question, not a formality.

case.label: Not an override
case.body: A bye is a zero. This is a forced move, not a read of Love against Allen.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love is hurt tonight or ruled out for Week 7 (then a free-agent quarterback, not Love), or Week 7 projections put a free quarterback more than two points above him and the swap is made anyway.
